description: This file contains functions related to upgrading firmware for Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It manages firmware partition selection, environment variable settings, and upgrade procedures.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on current boot environment and memory layout.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade process for Linksys devices, selecting partitions based on image magic numbers, and executing the necessary upgrade steps.
